scripts.build: sh -c 'ENV_FILE=${VALIDATION_WEB_ENV_FILE:-../web/.env.local}; if [ -f "$ENV_FILE" ]; then TMP_ENV=$(mktemp); grep -v "^NODE_ENV=" "$ENV_FILE" > "$TMP_ENV"; node --env-file="$TMP_ENV" --enable-source-maps --import tsx ./scripts/check-runtime.ts && node --env-file="$TMP_ENV" ./node_modules/next/dist/bin/next build; STATUS=$?; rm -f "$TMP_ENV"; exit $STATUS; else node --enable-source-maps --import tsx ./scripts/check-runtime.ts && node ./node_modules/next/dist/bin/next build; fi'
scripts.check-runtime: sh -c 'ENV_FILE=${VALIDATION_WEB_ENV_FILE:-../web/.env.local}; if [ -f "$ENV_FILE" ]; then TMP_ENV=$(mktemp); grep -v "^NODE_ENV=" "$ENV_FILE" > "$TMP_ENV"; node --env-file="$TMP_ENV" --enable-source-maps --import tsx ./scripts/check-runtime.ts; STATUS=$?; rm -f "$TMP_ENV"; exit $STATUS; else node --enable-source-maps --import tsx ./scripts/check-runtime.ts; fi'

scripts.dev: sh -c 'ENV_FILE=${VALIDATION_WEB_ENV_FILE:-../web/.env.local}; if [ -f "$ENV_FILE" ]; then TMP_ENV=$(mktemp); grep -v "^NODE_ENV=" "$ENV_FILE" > "$TMP_ENV"; node --env-file="$TMP_ENV" ./node_modules/next/dist/bin/next dev --port 3001; STATUS=$?; rm -f "$TMP_ENV"; exit $STATUS; else node ./node_modules/next/dist/bin/next dev --port 3001; fi'
